details:
Q1: What should this issue improve?
Choices:
A) One workflow or pipeline phase (name it in your answer, e.g. clarify, plan, implement, review/autofix, orchestrate, validate)
B) Documentation (README, docs/, agents.md fragments)
C) A specific script or helper under `scripts/` (name the file)
D) Close this issue as non-actionable and file a new one with a concrete problem statement (RECOMMENDED)
Q2: What does "better" mean here?
Choices:
A) Fix a specific bug or failure you saw (give the run link, error text or log line) (RECOMMENDED)
B) Lower cost or run time (say which phase and which metric)
C) Improve reliability, i.e. fewer stalls or retries (say which symptom)
D) Add a new capability (describe the behavior you expect)
Q3: How will we know the work is done?
Choices:
A) A named failing test or CI check passes (RECOMMENDED)
B) A named workflow run stops showing the observed symptom
C) A documented behavior change, written in the issue body
D) No concrete criterion yet; close this issue until one exists
